import importlib.util
import re
import sys

SK = "/private/tmp/adhd-eval-20261014/claude-H05-r1/workspace/.agents/skills/adhd-md/scripts/adhd_md.py"
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("adhd_md", SK)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)


def sections(path):
    doc = m.Doc(open(path, encoding="utf-8").read(), path)
    blocks = doc.body_blocks()
    lang = doc.lang
    prose_secs = []
    cur, structured = 0, False
    started = False
    detail = []
    for b in blocks:
        if b.kind == "heading":
            if started and not structured:
                prose_secs.append(cur)
                detail.append(("sec", cur))
            cur, structured, started = 0, False, True
            detail.append(("head", b.text))
            continue
        if b.kind == "code" or (b.kind == "list" and re.search(r"^\s*[-*+]\s+\[[ xX]\]", b.text, re.M)):
            structured = True
        u = m.units(m.prose_of(b), lang)
        cur += u
        detail.append(("block", b.kind, u, m.prose_of(b)[:40]))
    if started and not structured:
        prose_secs.append(cur)
        detail.append(("sec", cur))
    print("==", path)
    for d in detail:
        print("   ", d)
    print("    prose_secs:", prose_secs, "n=", len(prose_secs),
          "avg=", (sum(prose_secs) / len(prose_secs)) if prose_secs else None)
    print("    th frag:", doc.th["frag"], "min_plain_prose_sections:",
          m.RULE_LIMITS["X2"]["min_plain_prose_sections"])
    print("    lines:", len(doc.lines), "headings:", len([b for b in blocks if b.kind == "heading"]))


sections(sys.argv[1])
sections(sys.argv[2])

print("新增 --- 行数:", dst.count(b"---") - src.count(b"---"))

]
